note: Close-out walk of `2026-10-17-buying-credits-ui.md` against `design/design_handoff_the99_buying_credits`. ONE account STATE per run, seeded on a scratch branch before the run (`docs/superpowers/close-out-buying-credits.md` names each): `rich` (switch on, a 40-credit pack with a $5.31 payment, a 7-credit gift, the free allowance spent and 17 paid runs today) for every row here; `never`, `paused` and `off` for `buying-credits-closeout-page.json`; `gone` for `buying-credits-closeout-gone.json`; `admin` for `buying-credits-closeout-admin.json`. The deletion warning (D1/D2) opens from the shell's account menu, which no step verb presses inside a menu, so it is photographed by `pnpm probe:delete-warning` with `PROBE_SHOTS`. No row presses Buy (a real Stripe Session). The plan card (K1 to K6, R3, L7 live, the chip's expiring line) is added when U3b merges.
